children: Starlinks, a Gulf-based logistics and supply chain solutions provider, has selected Swisslog to deliver a major warehouse automation programme for a new aviation maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) facility in Saudi Arabia.

The programme is part of a wider supply chain solution for a leading Middle Eastern aviation company and will be implemented at a new MRO facility located in one of the region’s key aviation hubs. The facility is being developed to meet rising demand for aircraft maintenance services and spare parts logistics across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East.

Starlinks is responsible for the overall supply chain solution, including supply chain design, automation planning and operational implementation. Swisslog will provide the warehouse automation systems and software supporting inventory storage, material handling and distribution.

The integrated solution combines a high-density AutoStore system with pallet automation and Swisslog’s SynQ software platform. The system is designed to manage both small spare parts and palletised inventory through a coordinated material flow.

AutoStore will provide compact, high-density storage for MRO spare parts, with robots retrieving bins from a modular storage grid. The pallet automation system will include Swisslog Vectura stacker cranes, ProMove pallet conveyors, a pallet shuttle car, inbound transport systems and picking stations.
Together, the technologies will connect receiving, inspection, storage and order fulfilment processes, creating a seamless and highly automated logistics operation.

The project is designed to provide the facility with efficient storage, rapid access to critical aviation components and the capacity to accommodate future growth as regional airlines expand their fleets and increase passenger and cargo operations.

Alexander Komianos, Managing Director UAE & Solutions, Starlinks, said: "Saudi Arabia is investing heavily in aviation, logistics and industrial capabilities. These developments require supply chains that can scale efficiently and support increasingly demanding operations. By combining our logistics expertise with proven automation technologies from Swisslog, we are delivering a robust foundation for long term growth and operational excellence."

Rami Younes, General Manager, Swisslog Middle East, said: "We are proud to support Starlinks on this important programme. The combination of AutoStore technology, pallet automation and SynQ software will help ensure high inventory availability, efficient use of space and reliable material flow. These capabilities are essential as aviation supply chains continue to grow in scale and complexity across the region. We look forward to more landmark collaborations with Starlinks."
